name: comp-179
title: Switch With Status Label
description: A switch paired with a live On or Off caption, shown three times in a card of integration rows. Flipping a switch slides its knob across and swaps the word beside it.
use: In a settings list, when the on or off state should read as a word and not only as knob position.
avoid: The caption is fixed to On and Off, so wording like Enabled or Paused needs a source edit.
a11y: Each switch is named only Toggle switch and its visible caption is just On or Off, so three in one card are indistinguishable to a screen reader. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card holds an Integrations title, a line of grey helper text and three rows divided by faint rules. Each row has a bold name and a grey description on the left, and a small pill switch with On or Off on the right.
behaves: Clicking a switch slides its round knob to the other side and dulls the track when it turns off, while the caption flips between On and Off. Each switch acts on its own.
customise: The starting state, the On and Off words and the switch size live in the file, and the component takes no props. Change the caption or default by editing it; the card around it is demo code.
weight: light: One native switch with a sliding knob and a text swap; nothing runs when idle.
